title: Comprehensive Analysis of HD 105, A Young Solar System Analog
question: What are the stellar parameters, disc architecture, scattered-light albedo and dust properties of the young Solar analogue HD 105 and its debris disc?

evidence.quote: an ATCA measurement at 9 mm taken from (cite: 2017Marshall)

what.value: Gaia DR2 position, parallax, proper motion, G mag

evidence.quote: are taken from the Gaia DR 2 catalogue (cite: 2016Prusti; 2016Lindegren; 2018Brown)

recipe.method: clean of all four spectral windows with natural weighting
Grid of single-annulus models convolved with dirty beam, subtracted from image, residuals minimised
key_parameters: Grid over inclination, PA, semi-major axis, width, flux
assumptions: Vertical opening angle 10°, constant surface brightness exponent alpha=0

recipe.method: Optically thin M = F d^2 / (kappa B)
Continuum-subtracted cube, Keplerian spectro-spatial filtering over disc region, non-LTE mass limit
key_parameters: Cube -25 to 25 km/s, 0.5 km/s step; star 1.114 Msun
assumptions: CO co-located with dust, vertically flat, Keplerian

recipe.goal: Measure scattered-light radial profile and albedo
recipe.method: PSF subtraction (KLIP/PCA-RDI), elliptical-aperture averaging using ALMA geometry, throughput correction, albedo from Weinberger approximation
key_parameters: NICMOS F160W: 69 modes, 125 reference images; SPHERE: 100 PCA modes, 610 images from 22 stars

recipe.goal: Constrain grain size and composition from albedo
recipe.method: Hyperion radiative transfer for grain sizes 0.1-500 μm and silicate/ice mixtures
assumptions: Dust mass fixed from ALMA flux; Ldust/L* = 2.6e-4

recipe.method: Grid of radiative transfer models with power-law size distribution, annulus 70-100 au
key_parameters: amin 0.5-20.5 μm (41 values), q 2.5-4.5 (11 values), amax fixed 10 mm

evidence.quote: with an inclination of 50 $\pm$ 5 $^\circ$ with respect to the line of sight at a position angle of 15 $\pm$ 5$^\circ$
with an inclination of 50 $\pm$ 5 $^\circ$ with respect to the line of sight at a position angle of 15 $\pm$ 5$^\circ$
The total flux of the disc in the sub-millimetre, 1.45 $\pm$ 0.28 mJy
we calculate a mass of $0.035^{+0.013}_{-0.009}~$M$_{\oplus}$ for the dust
The spectro-spatial filtering yields a 3-$\sigma$ upper limit of 8.5 mJy kms$^{-1}$ to CO emission.
we determine a CO mass upper limit ranging from 2.5$\times10^{-7}$ to 2.5$\times10^{-6}$ $M_{\oplus}$
We derived an age of 50 $\pm$ 16 Myr
we obtain an albedo of 0.15 based on the NICMOS surface brightness (15 $\mu$Jy/arcsec$^{2}$)
or 0.06 based on the SPHERE measurement (5.9 $\mu$Jy/arcsec$^{2}$)
